Interface R and igraph with Infomap (external binary)

Source: R/modularity.R
run_infomap.Rd

This function exports an igraph network to Infomap's required format, runs Infomap, and imports the detected communities back into R as an igraph-compatible cluster object. It requires the installation of infomap in the system from https://www.mapequation.org/infomap/#Install if the network has the weight attribute, it will be used as the weight of the edges. The modularity stored in the returned object is computed from the partition using the weights (if present) and the directed argument. It works for networks with more than 1 connected component, but not for networks with isolated nodes.

Usage

run_infomap(
  graph,
  infomap_path = "infomap",
  output_dir = tempdir(),
  directed = TRUE,
  two_level = TRUE,
  seed = 123,
  return_df = FALSE
)

Arguments

graph

An igraph object.

infomap_path

Path to the Infomap binary (default assumes it's in system PATH).

output_dir

Temporary directory for Infomap results.

directed

Boolean: Treat the network as directed (default TRUE).

two_level

Boolean: Use two-level Infomap (default TRUE).

seed

Numeric: Random seed for Infomap (default 123).

return_df

Boolean: If TRUE, return a data.frame with node, module, and flow; if FALSE, return a community object (default).

Value

Either an igraph community object or a list with a data.frame and codelength.

Examples

# Example with the intermediate files in actual folder
py_infomap <- run_infomap(netData[[1]], output_dir = ".")

membership(py_infomap)
#>        Trachurus       Sardinella       Sciaenidae          Ariidae 
#>                3                3                3                1 
#>       Merluccius           Dentex   Pseudotolithus       Serranidae 
#>                3                1                1                3 
#>      Polynemidae  P. longirostris       Haemulidae Aristeu varidens 
#>                3                3                1                1 
#>   Small pelagics     Mesopelagics   Large pelagics    Demersal fish 
#>                3                3                2                3 
#>      Condrichtis     Cephalopodes     Miscelaneous          Penaeus 
#>                2                1                3                3 
#>   Marine mammals     Marine birds     Macrobenthos    Middlebenthos 
#>                4                1                3                3 
#>        Large Zoo        Small Zoo    Phytoplankton         Detritus

modularity(py_infomap)
